provenance.original: TSA also calculates a time burden associated with the applicant’s travel to and from the healthcare provider’s office, as well as time spent at the appointment and time to print and submit forms to TSA.  TSA assumes applicants travel to their healthcare provider by private vehicle and that it takes approximately 20 minutes (0.33 hours) to reach the provider’s office, resulting in a 0.66 hour round-trip (0.33 hours x 2).  In addition, TSA estimates that, on average, applicants will incur an in-office wait time of 11 minutes (0.18 hours), and will spend 30 minutes waiting for the healthcare provider to complete the forms (0.5 hours). The travel time burden is recognized for applicants only, as incumbents’ travel time is considered to be within the scope of their duties as TSA employees. provenance.original: Based on past estimates, TSA estimates that it will receive approximately 9,000 claims on an annual basis, or 750 per month.  Currently, all claims are submitted manually.  TSA estimates that it will take 30 minutes to complete and submit the forms, which results in an estimated burden of 4,500 hours.  Additionally, TSA collects payment information from those members of the public whose claims are approved by TSA.  TSA estimates that approximately 1,250 claims are approved each year.  TSA estimates it takes ten minutes (0.1667 hours) to submit payment information for an annual hour burden of 208 hours.  TSA estimates the public average annual hour burden of 4,708 hours (4,500 + 208).  To estimate annual hour burden cost, TSA multiples each hour burden by a fully-loaded wage rate of $38.91.  TSA estimates an annual hour burden cost of $175,095 for filing a claim and $8,106 for submitting payment information, for a total annual hour burden cost of this collection of $183,201.  Therefore, the total 3-year hour burden cost of this collection is $549,604 ($183,201 x 3 = $549,604).
